entities.name: Alejandro Cao de Benós de Les y Pérez
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alejandro Cao de Benós de Les y Pérez is a Spanish political activist. He is a Special Representative of the Foreign Ministry of North Korea. He is, according to himself, also the Special Delegate of North Korea's Committee for Cultural Relations with Foreign Countries. He is wanted by the US Federal Bureau of Investigation for conspiracy to violate the International Emergency Economic Powers Act (IEEPA).
